Data Science (B.A.)
Data Science Courses
- DS-UA 111 Principles of Data Science I (offered every semester) (4 cr)
- DS-UA 112 Principles of Data Science II (offered every semester) (4 cr)
- DS-UA 201 Causal Inference (offered every semester) (4 cr)
- DS-UA 202 Responsible Data Science (offered every spring) (4 cr)
Computer Science Courses
- CSCI-UA 101 Intro to Computer Science (4 cr)
- CSCI-UA 102 Data Structures (4 cr)
- CSCI-UA 473 Fundamentals of Machine Learning (4 cr)
- CSCI-UA 479 Data Management and Analysis (4 cr)
Mathematics Courses
- Select one of the following: (4 cr): MATH-UA 121 Calculus I; MATH-UA 131 Mathematics for Economics I
- Select one of the following: (4 cr): MATH-UA 122 Calculus II; MATH-UA 132 Mathematics for Economics II
- Select one of the following: (4 cr): MATH-UA 123 Calculus III; MATH-UA 133 Mathematics for Economics III
- MATH-UA 140 Linear Algebra (4 cr) or MATH-UA 148 Honors Linear Algebra
- MATH-UA 185 Probability & Statistics (4 cr)
Advanced Elective Requirement
- Select one of the following: (4 cr): DS-UA 205 Machine Learning for Climate Change; DS-UA 301 Advanced Topics in Data Science; DS-UA 302 Natural Language Processing
